Routed drive-time flow map

Source: R/flow_map.R
mysterymaps_flow_map.Rd

Draws a set of pre-computed routed paths (e.g. shortest road routes from each target site to its nearest provider) coloured by travel time, over a basemap. This function only renders; it does not call a routing API – build routes once with whatever routing engine is available (Valhalla, HERE, OSRM) and pass the result in as an sf LINESTRING layer.

Usage

mysterymaps_flow_map(
  routes,
  basemap,
  time_var,
  time_label = "Driving Time in Minutes",
  origin_points = NULL,
  destination_points = NULL,
  origin_label = "Origin Site",
  destination_label = "Destination Provider",
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  viridis_option = "inferno",
  crs = 5070
)

Arguments

routes

sf LINESTRING (or MULTILINESTRING) layer, one row per routed path.

basemap

sf polygon layer to draw beneath the routes.

time_var

character(1): numeric column in routes giving travel time, used to colour each route.

time_label

character(1): full-word legend title for time_var. Default "Driving Time in Minutes".

origin_points, destination_points

Optional sf POINT layers drawn on top of the routes (e.g. the target sites and the nearest providers). NULL omits either.

origin_label, destination_label

character(1): full-word shape legend labels for origin_points / destination_points.

title, subtitle, caption

Character labels. NULL omits.

viridis_option

character(1): passed to ggplot2::scale_color_viridis_c()'s option. Default "inferno".

crs

Projection for display. Default EPSG:5070 (Albers Equal Area), appropriate for the contiguous United States.

Value

A ggplot object. The caller saves it; this function writes nothing.

Details

A straight-line ("as the crow flies") distance map can badly overstate real access where the road network is constrained – a 60-mile straight radius around a site cut off by a single bridge or mountain pass can overstate the population actually reachable in that time by several-fold. Routing each path on the real road network and drawing it here, rather than drawing straight lines, is what keeps a flow map honest in that case.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
routes <- sf::st_sf(
  trip = c("a", "b"), minutes = c(12, 45),
  geometry = sf::st_sfc(
    sf::st_linestring(rbind(c(-99, 40), c(-98, 40.5))),
    sf::st_linestring(rbind(c(-98, 41), c(-97, 41.2))),
    crs = 4326))
basemap <- sf::st_sf(geometry = sf::st_sfc(
  sf::st_polygon(list(cbind(c(-100, -96, -96, -100, -100), c(39, 39, 43, 43, 39)))),
  crs = 4326))
mysterymaps_flow_map(routes, basemap, time_var = "minutes")
}
